Use the provided RIVEN — TWO YEARS LATER, RIVEN'S ISOLATED FOREST CABIN, WOODEN TRAINING SWORD, and BROKEN SWORD references.

Keep Riven's exact face, pale-blonde hair, body proportions, clothing, and overall appearance consistent with the RIVEN — TWO YEARS LATER reference.

Keep the same isolated cabin, outdoor training clearing, surrounding mountain forest, terrain, vegetation, and atmosphere established in the previous scene.

The wooden training sword must remain the same large, broad, two-handed wooden practice sword shown in its reference.

The Broken Sword must remain exactly consistent with its reference:
the original handle and only the remaining lower section of the massive broad blade.
The missing upper section does not return.

=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Same cold mountain environment established in the previous scene.

Natural human movement.

Realistic two-handed greatsword practice.

Dynamic but readable cinematic camera movement.

Natural cinematic cuts.

No dialogue.

No subtitles.

No background music.

Use natural sound:

Riven's training shouts,
strong breathing,
boots moving across dirt,
wooden sword movement,
wooden practice impacts,
mountain wind,
forest ambience.

The first half of the scene should feel significantly more intense than the training shown in the previous scene.

Riven remains highly skilled and technically controlled.

=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Continue directly from Riven's morning training.

Instead of repeating the previous wide composition, begin much closer to the action.

Use Riven's movement and the wooden training sword passing close across the camera as a natural visual transition into a more intense phase of her practice.

Riven trains at a much faster and stronger rhythm than before.

During the training, she notices an unusual red-orange glow beyond the forest.

She stops and sees dark smoke rising in the distance.

Something far away is burning.

Riven immediately returns to the cabin.

She leaves the wooden training sword behind and takes the Broken Sword.

The Broken Sword remains physically damaged and completely dormant.

Riven then leaves the cabin and heads into the forest toward the distant fire.

Shot 1 — MOTION TRANSITION

Do not repeat the wide final composition from the previous scene.

Begin immediately with a close low-angle tracking shot beside Riven's boots in the training clearing.

Riven is already moving.

Her boot makes a strong lateral step across the dirt as she changes stance.

Small pieces of dirt shift naturally beneath her foot.

The lower portion of the large wooden training sword enters the foreground.

Riven turns her body into the next practice movement.

The broad wooden sword sweeps rapidly across the camera from one side to the other.

WHOOSH.

The wooden blade passes extremely close to the lens and briefly fills most of the frame with natural motion blur.

Use the movement of the wooden sword as a cinematic visual transition.

As the blade clears the lens, reveal Riven much closer in a medium full-body composition.

She is already continuing her training.

She immediately redirects the wooden sword into another movement.

"HAH!"

Continue directly into the training sequence.

=== Shot 2 — HIGH-INTENSITY TRAINING ===

Stay close to Riven.

Her training rhythm is now noticeably faster and stronger than in the previous scene.

Keep the sequence simple and readable.

Riven performs a powerful diagonal practice swing.

She controls the momentum and turns.

Her feet reposition quickly.

She follows with a broad horizontal practice swing.

WHOOSH.

A short controlled training shout:

"HAH!"

She changes stance and immediately continues into another strong two-handed movement.

The wooden sword must feel large and substantial.

Riven controls its momentum using her entire body:

legs,
hips,
shoulders,
and both hands.

Her movements remain precise and experienced.

Use energetic camera tracking around Riven while maintaining clear full-body movement.

Show brief details naturally within the sequence:

her boots moving across the worn earth,

both hands tightening around the wooden grip,

the broad wooden blade moving rapidly through the air,

her pale-blonde hair moving around her face,

and her focused expression.

Her breathing becomes stronger as the rhythm continues.

She does not stop between every movement.

The training flows continuously.

=== Shot 3 — THE TRAINING TARGET ===

Riven redirects herself toward the simple wooden training target in the clearing.

She plants her feet.

A strong controlled practice strike.

THUD.

The wooden target shakes from the impact.

Riven immediately resets.

Another strong movement.

THUD.

Small pieces of old wood fall naturally from the training target.

Riven steps back.

She breathes strongly.

But she immediately prepares for another sequence.

She raises the large wooden practice sword again.

Just before she begins—

something changes.

A faint warm red-orange light appears across part of the training clearing.

Riven notices it.

She stops.

The sudden absence of training sounds creates a strong contrast.

Only Riven's breathing and the mountain wind remain.

=== Shot 4 — THE DISTANT FIRE ===

Hold briefly on Riven.

A subtle red-orange reflection touches one side of her face.

Her expression shifts from training focus to alert attention.

Riven slowly lowers the wooden sword.

She turns toward the forest.

Follow her gaze.

Beyond the dark trees and distant mountain slopes, part of the sky has become red-orange.

A large column of dark smoke rises above the distant forest.

The source itself remains mostly hidden behind the terrain and trees.

Do not fully reveal the burning location yet.

Only establish:

the distant red-orange glow,

dark smoke rising into the sky,

and the scale of a fire somewhere beyond the forest.

Cut back to Riven.

She watches silently for a brief moment.

Then she reacts immediately.

Riven turns and moves quickly toward the cabin.

=== Shot 5 — THE BROKEN SWORD ===

Follow Riven into the cabin.

The interior remains exactly consistent with the established environment.

Riven leaves the large wooden training sword near the entrance.

She does not take it with her.

She moves deeper into the cabin.

Her attention shifts toward the quiet corner of the room.

The Broken Sword rests there.

Riven stops.

The pace becomes still for a brief moment.

She looks at the Broken Sword.

No flashback.

No dialogue.

Riven approaches.

She reaches down and closes her hand around the familiar grip.

She lifts the Broken Sword.

Show its physical condition clearly.

Only the handle and remaining lower section of the massive broad blade remain.

The upper portion is gone.

The damaged edge remains clearly visible.

The rune markings remain inactive.

No magical energy appears.

Riven briefly looks at the sword in her hand.

Keep her expression restrained and focused.

Then she secures the Broken Sword and turns toward the exit.

=== Shot 6 — LEAVING ===

Cut outside the cabin from a new cinematic angle.

The door opens.

Riven steps outside carrying the Broken Sword.

The wooden training sword has been left inside.

The environment is beginning to darken.

Through gaps between the trees, the distant red-orange glow is now clearly visible.

Dark smoke continues rising beyond the forest.

Riven stops briefly outside the cabin.

She looks toward the distant fire.

Then she begins moving along the forest path toward it.

Follow behind her.

Do not make this a heroic walk.

Riven is simply moving with clear purpose toward something unusual happening beyond the forest.

The Broken Sword remains visibly damaged and dormant.

Gradually widen the camera as Riven moves deeper between the trees.

The cabin recedes behind her.

Ahead, the distant red glow remains visible through the forest.

End with Riven continuing toward the source of the smoke.

Do not reveal the full burning village yet.

Do not reveal soldiers yet.

Do not reveal the creature yet.

CUT.

Keep the same isolated cabin, outdoor training clearing, surrounding mountain forest, terrain, vegetation, and atmosphere established in the previous scene.

the original handle and only the remaining lower section of the massive broad blade.

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Same cold mountain environment established in the previous scene.

Natural human movement.

Realistic two-handed greatsword practice.

Dynamic but readable cinematic camera movement.

Natural cinematic cuts.

No dialogue.

No subtitles.

No background music.

Use natural sound:

Riven's training shouts,
strong breathing,
boots moving across dirt,
wooden sword movement,
wooden practice impacts,
mountain wind,
forest ambience.

Riven remains highly skilled and technically controlled.

=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Continue directly from Riven's morning training.

Instead of repeating the previous wide composition, begin much closer to the action.

Use Riven's movement and the wooden training sword passing close across the camera as a natural visual transition into a more intense phase of her practice.

Riven trains at a much faster and stronger rhythm than before.

During the training, she notices an unusual red-orange glow beyond the forest.

She stops and sees dark smoke rising in the distance.

Something far away is burning.

Riven immediately returns to the cabin.

She leaves the wooden training sword behind and takes the Broken Sword.

Shot 1 — MOTION TRANSITION

Do not repeat the wide final composition from the previous scene.

Begin immediately with a close low-angle tracking shot beside Riven's boots in the training clearing.

Riven is already moving.

Her boot makes a strong lateral step across the dirt as she changes stance.

Small pieces of dirt shift naturally beneath her foot.

The lower portion of the large wooden training sword enters the foreground.

Riven turns her body into the next practice movement.

The broad wooden sword sweeps rapidly across the camera from one side to the other.

WHOOSH.

The wooden blade passes extremely close to the lens and briefly fills most of the frame with natural motion blur.

Use the movement of the wooden sword as a cinematic visual transition.

As the blade clears the lens, reveal Riven much closer in a medium full-body composition.

She is already continuing her training.

She immediately redirects the wooden sword into another movement.

"HAH!"

Continue directly into the training sequence.

=== Shot 2 — HIGH-INTENSITY TRAINING ===

Stay close to Riven.

Her training rhythm is now noticeably faster and stronger than in the previous scene.

Keep the sequence simple and readable.

Riven performs a powerful diagonal practice swing.

She controls the momentum and turns.

Her feet reposition quickly.

She follows with a broad horizontal practice swing.

WHOOSH.

A short controlled training shout:

"HAH!"

She changes stance and immediately continues into another strong two-handed movement.

The wooden sword must feel large and substantial.

Riven controls its momentum using her entire body:

legs,
hips,
shoulders,
and both hands.

Her movements remain precise and experienced.

Use energetic camera tracking around Riven while maintaining clear full-body movement.

Show brief details naturally within the sequence:

her boots moving across the worn earth,

both hands tightening around the wooden grip,

the broad wooden blade moving rapidly through the air,

her pale-blonde hair moving around her face,

and her focused expression.

Her breathing becomes stronger as the rhythm continues.

She does not stop between every movement.

The training flows continuously.

Riven redirects herself toward the simple wooden training target in the clearing.

She plants her feet.

A strong controlled practice strike.

THUD.

The wooden target shakes from the impact.

Riven immediately resets.

Another strong movement.

THUD.

Small pieces of old wood fall naturally from the training target.

Riven steps back.

She breathes strongly.

But she immediately prepares for another sequence.

She raises the large wooden practice sword again.

Just before she begins—

something changes.

A faint warm red-orange light appears across part of the training clearing.

Riven notices it.

She stops.

The sudden absence of training sounds creates a strong contrast.

Only Riven's breathing and the mountain wind remain.

=== Shot 4 — THE DISTANT FIRE ===

Hold briefly on Riven.

A subtle red-orange reflection touches one side of her face.

Her expression shifts from training focus to alert attention.

Riven slowly lowers the wooden sword.

She turns toward the forest.

Follow her gaze.

Beyond the dark trees and distant mountain slopes, part of the sky has become red-orange.

A large column of dark smoke rises above the distant forest.

The source itself remains mostly hidden behind the terrain and trees.

Do not fully reveal the burning location yet.

Only establish:

the distant red-orange glow,

dark smoke rising into the sky,

and the scale of a fire somewhere beyond the forest.

Cut back to Riven.

She watches silently for a brief moment.

Then she reacts immediately.

Riven turns and moves quickly toward the cabin.

=== Shot 5 — THE BROKEN SWORD ===

Follow Riven into the cabin.

The interior remains exactly consistent with the established environment.

Riven leaves the large wooden training sword near the entrance.

She does not take it with her.

She moves deeper into the cabin.

Her attention shifts toward the quiet corner of the room.

The Broken Sword rests there.

Riven stops.

The pace becomes still for a brief moment.

She looks at the Broken Sword.

No flashback.

No dialogue.

Riven approaches.

She reaches down and closes her hand around the familiar grip.

She lifts the Broken Sword.

Show its physical condition clearly.

Only the handle and remaining lower section of the massive broad blade remain.

The upper portion is gone.

The damaged edge remains clearly visible.

The rune markings remain inactive.

No magical energy appears.

Riven briefly looks at the sword in her hand.

Keep her expression restrained and focused.

Then she secures the Broken Sword and turns toward the exit.

=== Shot 6 — LEAVING ===

Cut outside the cabin from a new cinematic angle.

The door opens.

Riven steps outside carrying the Broken Sword.

The wooden training sword has been left inside.

The environment is beginning to darken.

Through gaps between the trees, the distant red-orange glow is now clearly visible.

Dark smoke continues rising beyond the forest.

Riven stops briefly outside the cabin.

She looks toward the distant fire.

Then she begins moving along the forest path toward it.

Follow behind her.

Do not make this a heroic walk.

Riven is simply moving with clear purpose toward something unusual happening beyond the forest.

The Broken Sword remains visibly damaged and dormant.

Gradually widen the camera as Riven moves deeper between the trees.

The cabin recedes behind her.

Ahead, the distant red glow remains visible through the forest.

End with Riven continuing toward the source of the smoke.

Do not reveal the full burning village yet.

Do not reveal soldiers yet.

Do not reveal the creature yet.

CUT.
